records.text: By: LAFAYETTE TOWNSHIP 2026-08-31 thru 2026-10-15 BALLASH ROAD CULVERT NO. 31 BALLASH RD WILL BE CLOSED FOR 45 DAYS BEGINNING MONDAY, AUGUST 31, 2026 FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF CULVERT NO. 31 WHICH LIES APPROXIMATELY 1,800 FEET SOUTH OF WEDGEWOOD ROAD. THE CULVERT IS NORTH OF ADDRESS 6570 BALLASH ROAD

By: MEDINA COUNTY ENGINEER 2026-09-28 thru 2026-10-02 VANDEMARK ROAD Culvert # 16 VANDEMARK ROAD IN CHATHAM TWP WILL BE CLOSED BETWEEN RODGERS ROAD AND CHIPPEWA ROAD, APPROXIMATELY 125 FEET NORTH OF RODGERS ROAD, FOR ROAD CULVERT REPAIR AND GUARDRAIL REPLACEMENT MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 28, 2026 THROUGH FRIDAY, OCTOBER 2, 2026. 7690 VANDEMARK RD IS TO THE NORTH AND 7715 VANDEMARK RD IS SOUTH OF THE CLOSURE.

By: MEDINA COUNTY ENGINEER 2026-09-28 thru 2026-12-07 GREENWICH ROAD BRIDGE 10 GREENWICH RD WILL BE CLOSED BETWEEN DEERFIELD DRIVE AND WESTFIELD ROAD FOR BRIDGE NO 10 REPLACEMENT BEGINNING MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 28, 2026 FOR 70 DAYS, THROUGH MONDAY, DECEMBER 7, 2026.
